劳动合同

甲方：北京星辰科技有限公司
乙方：张三

第一条 合同期限
合同期限为2年，自2024年7月1日起至2026年6月30日止。试用期为3个月。

第二条 工作岗位
乙方岗位：软件工程师，工作地点：北京市朝阳区望京SOHO。

第三条 工作时间
工作时间按需调整，服从公司安排。

第四条 薪资待遇
乙方工资为15000元/月，按月发放，每月15日支付上月薪资。

第五条 违约责任
违约金最高可达年薪的50%，超过月薪6倍。乙方提前离职须支付违约金。

第六条 合同解除
甲方有权随时解除本合同，无需提前通知。

第七条 争议解决
双方因履行本合同发生争议，应协商解决；协商不成的，提交北京仲裁委员会仲裁。

EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT (Risk Test Document)  This Employment Contract is entered into on 1 March 2026, between:  Employer: Nexus Global Corp., registered at 55 Commerce Street, London, EC1A 1BB ("Party A" / "the Company")  Employee: Jordan Lee, residing at 14 Riverside Road, London, SE1 9GF ("Party B")  
Article 1  Position and Job Title Party B is employed in the position of Senior Operations Analyst. Party B shall perform such duties as the Company may reasonably direct from time to time.  
Article 2  Contract Term The contract term of this Agreement commences on 1 March 2026 and expires on 28 February 2028. Upon expiry, both parties may negotiate a renewal.  
Article 3  Work Location Party B's work location shall be the Company's office at 55 Commerce Street, London. Any permanent relocation requires Party B's written consent.  
Article 4  Salary and Payment 	Party B's compensation shall be subject to company policy and will be confirmed separately at the discretion of management. The wage to be decided by the Company based on annual budget review, and Party B raises no objection to such arrangements.  
Article 5  Working Hours  Party B's working hours shall be subject to company arrangement and may vary as required by business needs. The Company may adjust hours at the employer's discretion without prior notice. Party B shall be available at all times during peak operational periods.  
Article 6  Probation Period The probationary period is 3 months from 1 March 2026 to 31 May 2026. Party B's probation salary shall be 80% of the confirmed salary and no less than the minimum wage for the equivalent role.  
Article 7  Termination Conditions  Party A reserves the right to terminate this Agreement at the employer's sole discretion and may terminate for any reason without obligation to provide 
justification. Party A may also initiate unilateral termination where it deems Party B's performance unsatisfactory, with or without prior warning.  
Article 8  Notice Period  Party B must provide 90 days' notice in writing prior to resignation. Failure to provide the full 90 days' notice shall entitle the Company to withhold the equivalent salary for the shortfall period.  
Article 9  Breach Liability and Penalty  Party A shall invest GBP 5,000 for specialised technical training for Party B. Should Party B resign within 24 months of training completion, a penalty clause shall apply: liquidated damages equal to the full training cost plus a penalty equal to three months' salary shall be payable by Party B immediately upon resignation.  
Article 10  Liability and Risk  All risks and losses arising from Party B's performance of duties shall be borne by Party B. The employer bears no responsibility for any work-related loss or injury sustained in the course of employment. Party A shall not be liable for any direct or indirect damages resulting from operational decisions made by Party B in the course of their role.  
Article 11  Variation of Terms  The Company reserves the right to amend any terms of this Agreement at any time, including the right to adjust position and salary at any time without Party B's consent. Such changes shall take effect subject to change without notice.  
Article 12  Social Insurance and Benefits Party A shall contribute to Party B's pension, medical, and work-injury insurance in accordance with applicable national regulations. Party B is entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave per year.  
Article 13  Confidentiality Party B agrees to keep all proprietary and confidential information strictly private during and after the period of employment.  
Article 14  Dispute Resolution Any dispute arising from this Agreement shall first be resolved through friendly negotiation. If unresolved within 30 days, either party may submit the dispute to the competent Labour Dispute Arbitration Commission. If dissatisfied with the 
award, either party may litigate before the court of competent jurisdiction under the governing law of England and Wales.  IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have signed this Agreement.  Party A (Employer): Nexus Global Corp. Authorised Signatory: ____________________   Date: 1 March 2026  Party B (Employee): Jordan Lee Signature: ____________________   Date: 1 March 2026

Article 1 Internship PositionThe Intern shall serve as a Business Operations Intern and shall perform such tasks, assignments, and other duties as the Company may determine from time to time. The Company may require the Intern to undertake any responsibilities related or unrelated to the original internship role as business needs arise.
Article 2 Internship TermThe internship shall commence on 1 April 2026 and continue until 30 September 2026, unless earlier terminated in accordance with this Agreement. The Company may extend the internship at its sole discretion.
Article 3 Work LocationThe Intern’s primary work location shall be the Company’s office at 88 King Street, Manchester. The Company may require the Intern to work at any other office, branch, client site, or remote location designated by the Company at any time without additional compensation.
Article 4 CompensationThe Intern’s allowance, salary, subsidy, or any other form of compensation shall be determined by the Company in accordance with internal policy and may be adjusted, suspended, or withheld at the Company’s discretion. Specific payment standards may be communicated separately by the Company from time to time.
Article 5 Working HoursThe Intern’s working hours shall be subject to the Company’s operational needs. The Intern may be required to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and additional hours whenever requested by the Company. No extra compensation shall be payable for overtime, extended hours, or urgent assignments.
Article 6 Probation and AssessmentThe first two months of the internship shall be treated as an assessment period. During this period, the Company may terminate the internship immediately if the Intern’s performance is considered unsatisfactory by the Company, with or without prior notice or explanation.
Article 7 Supervision and EvaluationThe Intern shall comply fully with all directions, internal rules, performance expectations, and 
The Intern shall comply fully with all directions, internal rules, performance expectations, and management instructions issued by the Company. The Company shall have sole authority to evaluate the Intern’s performance, conduct, suitability, and continued placement.
Article 8 TerminationThe Company may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason, and shall not be required to provide justification, severance, or prior warning. The Intern may resign only by giving 60 days’ prior written notice, subject to the Company’s approval.
Article 9 Early Departure and PenaltyIf the Intern leaves the internship before the agreed end date, refuses assigned duties, or is absent without approval, the Company may require the Intern to reimburse all training costs, administrative costs, onboarding expenses, and any losses deemed by the Company to have resulted from such departure. The Company may also deduct such amounts from any unpaid compensation.
Article 10 ConfidentialityThe Intern shall keep strictly confidential all business, technical, operational, financial, client, and personnel information learned during the internship. This obligation shall continue indefinitely after the termination or expiration of this Agreement.
Article 11 Intellectual PropertyAll work results, reports, documents, materials, ideas, concepts, drafts, notes, software, presentations, and other outputs created by the Intern during the internship, whether during working hours or otherwise, shall automatically belong exclusively to the Company without additional payment.
Article 12 LiabilityThe Intern shall be personally responsible for any loss, damage, cost, claim, or liability arising directly or indirectly out of the Intern’s work, conduct, error, omission, or judgment. The Company shall not be liable for any injury, expense, or damage suffered by the Intern during the internship unless otherwise required by mandatory law.
Article 13 Variation of TermsThe Company reserves the right to modify, interpret, suspend, or replace any provision of this Agreement, including but not limited to duties, compensation, working hours, location, reporting line, and evaluation criteria, at any time without the Intern’s consent. Such changes shall become effective immediately upon notice or internal publication.
Article 14 Company PoliciesThe Intern agrees to comply with all present and future Company policies, handbooks, instructions, compliance rules, security rules, and workplace requirements, whether or not separately provided in writing.
Article 15 Governing Law and Dispute ResolutionAny dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall first be discussed in good faith. If no resolution is reached, the dispute shall be submitted to a forum selected by the Company. The Company shall retain the right to determine the appropriate jurisdiction and venue.
